action: No action needed; for awareness. EU institution staff and contractors should watch for notices from the Commission and for phishing that uses leaked personal details.
date_note: Date is the publication of Politico's report; disruption is said to have lasted over 10 days before that.
exec: A breach at an EU institution may expose staff personal data; the full scope is not yet known.
plain: Politico reports a cyberattack on the European Commission that may have exposed a large amount of personal data. The Commission says it has contained most of it.
summary: Politico reported on 19 November that the European Commission was hit by a cyber campaign that disrupted systems for more than 10 days and may have compromised a large amount of personal data. Some applications were taken offline and most are restored. Spokesperson Thomas Regnier said individual systems were targeted and those concerned were informed. No attacker has been named and the number of people affected is not stated.
title: European Commission hit by cyber campaign; personal data may be compromised, Politico reports

validation.note: Anadolu and La Libre both relay Politico's report (not read directly); they are not independent of it, so single source. The Commission spokesperson statement is quoted in both.
